promises.quote: The coroner has reported that there is a risk of future deaths owing to the fact that there were no smoke detectors fitted to the property. A partial re-wire had taken place in 2008, but no hard wired detection equipment installed, as per the existing Electrical Specification (in which hard-wired smoke detectors are only required to be installed as part of a full re-wire).
promises.summary: Install hard-wired smoke detectors in all properties

concerns.quote: there were no smoke alarms fitted to the property

reports.title: Netlyn Robinson: Prevention of Future Deaths Report

concerns.quote: In evidence it became apparent that there was no falls pendant or alarm provided on Mrs [name redacted] return home despite her previously having one when last at home. There appeared to be no process in place to check whether there was a fully operational alarm system in place when needed. Further that Mrs Robinson was not consulted about the lack of an alarm until she had arrived home, thus no process in place to provide a person with relevant information in order that they are able to decide

The telephone line was not connected. There appeared to be no process in place to check that telephones are working and that a vulnerable person has the ability to call for assistance (emergency or otherwise) or communicate with friends/relatives
With a lack of alarm or phone line there was still no risk assessment as to how an alarm could be raised
concerns.hazard: absence of risk assessment for alarm activation

concerns.quote: The heating was not working/turned on and again there appeared to be no process in place to check premises had heating, running water or smoke alarms and therefore was fit and safe for a vulnerable person to return to
concerns.hazard: lack of heating and safety checks

concerns.quote: The social worker stated he had been trained on the job to risk assess. He had never been shown a check list for the numerous issues that need to be checked prior to allowing a vulnerable person to be returned home
concerns.hazard: lack of risk assessment checklist training

concerns.quote: It was acknowledged that the home was owned by Mrs Robinson however there appeared no processes in place to outline what social services would and would not do to ensure that Mrs [name redacted] premises were suitable
concerns.hazard: absence of processes to assess premises suitability

links.explanation: Both reports highlight the absence of smoke alarms in a dwelling occupied by a vulnerable person. The later report adds that there is no process to verify the presence of alarms (along with heating and water) before allowing return.
